allExperience.companyDescription:
Design and deploy LLM-powered systems for real-world business applications, from prototype to production.
Built SQL-based AI agents that convert natural-language questions into optimised database queries over PostgreSQL.
Developed RAG pipelines using embedding models and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone) for grounded, context-aware responses.
Integrated local and cloud LLMs (Ollama, Groq API) into scalable services, and built voice-enabled assistants with speech-to-text and text-to-speech.
Orchestrated multi-step AI workflows with LangChain and LangGraph; improved response quality through prompt engineering, evaluation, and logging.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ship and maintain AI solutions in production.
Technologies: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, LangChain, LangGraph, Ollama, Docker, AWS, Git

Teach the Huawei HCCDA-AI certification course end to end: Python, data preprocessing (Pandas, NumPy), machine learning, and deep learning.
Cover core ML algorithms, gradient descent, and neural network training and evaluation using Scikit-learn and PyTorch.
Teach generative AI topics: LLM APIs, RAG architectures, Hugging Face pipelines, diffusion models, prompt chaining, and agentic AI.
Design exercises, assessments, and practical assignments to measure learner progress.
Technologies: Python, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face, RAG, GenAI, Agentic AI

GeniHunt: Built an automated data pipeline that ingests data from external APIs, parses and cleans XML responses, and loads structured records into PostgreSQL; deployed on AWS EC2 with scheduled daily cron execution.
EChecker: Developed an LLM-powered document extraction and autofill service (FastAPI, Mistral) that populates SME assessment forms from uploaded documents.
Ad Detection System: Built an audio advertisement detection system using audio fingerprinting with timestamp generation.
Managed PostgreSQL databases, including schema design and query optimisation.
Containerised applications with Docker and deployed to AWS EC2 using Git and AWS CodeCommit.
Technologies: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS EC2, CodeCommit, Git, Mistral
